Latest 14-day rolling staker APY (inflation + MEV, net of commission) per validator, keyed by vote account. The window is fixed here rather than a query param: this is the single number the Explore validators list renders and sorts by, so changing it is a coordinated apy-api + validators-api + marinade-web change, never a one-sided edit. A validator appears only when it has rewards in every epoch of the window — newly staked, unstaked and inactive validators are omitted rather than reported at a diluted or zero APY, so absence means "no comparable rate", not 0%.

info.title: APY API
info.description: API for retrieving rolling and per-epoch APY for liquid tokens, validators, and Marinade products

lowerTime.description: Unix timestamp representing the time at the start of the range

upperTime.description: Unix timestamp representing the time at the end of the range

lowerPrice.description: Price at the start of the range

upperPrice.description: Price at the end of the range

times.description: Array of Unix timestamps representing the times for each APY value

values.description: Array of APY values corresponding to the times

labels.description: Array of labels representing the ranges of price updates

time.description: Unix timestamp of the epoch boundary the value was computed at

apy.description: APY for the specified recipe incentives (0.07 = 7%). USDG incentives are currently switched off, so this is always 0 until they are funded again.

stake.description: Stake active on the validator providing the recipe incentives (SOL)

solPrice.description: Solana price in USD at the time of the APY calculation

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the data was last updated

time.description: Unix timestamp at the end of the epoch

epochs.description: Per-epoch APY entries, sorted by epoch ascending

time.description: Unix timestamp at the end of the epoch

pmpe.description: Per-mille-per-epoch — SOL earned per 1000 SOL staked in this epoch. Equivalent to (bump - 1) * 1000.

epochs.description: Per-epoch PMPE entries, sorted by epoch ascending
